def grover_iteration_count(
    n_items: int) -> int:
  return round((math.pi/4) *
    math.sqrt(n_items))

def test_grover_iteration_count():
  # Verified in Lesson 19:
  # (pi/4)*sqrt(1024)=25.1327...
  assert grover_iteration_count(
    1024) == 25
caption: Not a throwaway check — the exact numeric claim from Lesson 19, now locked into the suite so a future refactor can't silently drift.
